employers.description: Aperture Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech developing oligonucleotide therapeutics for neurodegenerative diseases, with programs focused on ALS and frontotemporal dementia (FTD). The company uses machine learning to mine large-scale genomic and clinical datasets to identify naturally occurring gene variants that protect against neurodegeneration, then designs therapies that mimic those protective mechanisms. Their team spans computational biologists, neuroscientists, and R&D operations staff.
